author: bardic-inspiration
name: Stoneward Plate
summary: Plate armor that turns aside blows and makes the wearer hard to move.
description: The plates are shaped from a single block of grey stone hollowed with fire, and the seams are almost invisible. Cathedrals have been built with less patience.

stats.effect: You have a +2 bonus to AC while wearing this armor. As a Bonus Action, you can plant your feet; until the start of your next turn, you can't be moved against your will and you have Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.
